blurb: We just headed to the Drumheller area on a Saturday night and ended up staying in this campground. Walking distance from the Last Chance Saloon and if you hike up the badlands behind the campground , you get a nice view of the surrounding area . Free WiFi and dry toilets, which are very clean .
